entries.title: App visuals load instantly
entries.body: The Milestone logo and branding now appear the moment any page opens — no more blank space or delayed flash while navigating between sign-in, your workspace, or the loading screen.

entries.title: Faster experience on every visit
entries.body: Images and app assets are now stored in your browser after the first load, so returning to MTI Brain or switching pages feels significantly snappier. No waiting for the same visuals to re-download.
